variants.label: WLSMV
variants.model_syntax:
# =======================================
  # Reflective Measurement Model
  # =======================================
  # This is the EFA-motivated version
  # Here rough road belongs to the non-power side. 
  
  PowerPercEFA =~ bev_better_towing +
             bev_better_accel +
             bev_better_power
  
  NonPowerPercEFA =~ bev_better_comfort +
               bev_better_safety +
               bev_better_reliability +
               bev_better_roughroad

fornell_larcker.criterion: Both AVEs must exceed the squared latent correlation.
